notes.text: ד״ה א׳ פ״ד-כח gives I Chronicles chapter 4, verse 28: the final 28 must not be dropped. This is the supplied locator, without independent named-edition verification; earlier machine פ״דהבה differs.

Rav Chanan bar Moladah is named in the linked Bavli transmitting two statements in Rav Huna’s name. The Chronicles reference supplies the town name. Hyman’s short notice does not connect the man to that town.
